description: Generic typed-decision benchmark: 100 questions over 85 states, hand-labelled, no domain-specific data. Types: noul (true/false statement about the state), choice (one option), score (ordered levels). Options/levels are either an inline list or the name of an option set; option dicts map label -> description. The last 26 questions (multi-hop, negation, pragmatics, arithmetic, sarcasm, word-count and format compliance, distractor-heavy reading) were added as a harder tier.
